chunks: Muhammad is but a messenger; messengers had gone before him. So if he dies or is killed, will you turn back on your heels? And he who turns back on his heels will not harm God at all. And God will reward the grateful.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Prophet Muhammad's death in relation to the faith of the believers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (3:144) is pivotal for establishing the concept of *Ismah* (infallibility) and the continuity of divine guidance through the Imams, proving that the Prophet’s mortality does not break the chain of leadership. It reassures the community that loyalty to the message transcends the physical presence of the Messenger, a principle that underpins the Shia belief in the enduring authority of the Ahl al-Bayt after his passing. The promise of reward for the 'grateful' (*ash-shakireen*) is often interpreted as referring to those who remained steadfast in recognizing the true successors of the Prophet.
